# Shared helpers

<!-- Generated by scripts/shared-helpers.py from the doc comments; do not edit. -->

Before writing a small helper, use one of these. To add one, give a public Base function a one-line purpose and a `Shared helper:` example line in its doc comment, then run `python3 scripts/shared-helpers.py`.

| Helper | Purpose | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bilibi_agent_api::invalid` | Refuse one input field with a message the caller can show. | `return Err(bilibi_agent_api::invalid("code", "is already taken"));` | [agent_api/src/input.rs](agent_api/src/input.rs) |
| `bilibi_agent_api::optional_text_field` | Read an optional text input, trimmed; `None` when absent, null or blank. | `let note = bilibi_agent_api::optional_text_field(input, "note");` | [agent_api/src/input.rs](agent_api/src/input.rs) |
| `bilibi_agent_api::text_field` | Read a text input, trimmed; empty when the field is absent or null. | `let code = bilibi_agent_api::text_field(input, "code");` | [agent_api/src/input.rs](agent_api/src/input.rs) |
| `bilibi_locale::money` | Show an amount with exactly `places` decimals and comma thousands groups. | `let shown = bilibi_locale::money(total, currency.minor_units);` | [locale/src/money.rs](locale/src/money.rs) |
| `bilibi_ui::active_badge` | Render the Active (success) or Inactive (neutral) status badge. | `.slot("status", bilibi_ui::active_badge(account.active))` | [ui/src/components.rs](ui/src/components.rs) |
| `bilibi_ui::params::blank_to_none` | Trim text; `None` when it is absent or only whitespace. | `let note = bilibi_ui::params::blank_to_none(Some(&draft.note));` | [ui/src/params.rs](ui/src/params.rs) |
| `bilibi_ui::status_badge` | Render a dotted status badge of `kind` showing `text`. | `.slot("status", bilibi_ui::status_badge(BadgeKind::Success, "Posted"))` | [ui/src/components.rs](ui/src/components.rs) |
